entries.title: Genesis 14:1
segments: Shinar;

Ellasar; apparently lying between Shinar and Elam. 
 
  Elam; Persia. 
 
  Nations; several small nations, whose situation is unknown.

entries.title: Genesis 14:2
segments: King of Sodom; the word king is used in the Bible for the ruler of a city or small district; and for the chief of a clan or tribe, as well as for the ruler of a nation.

entries.title: Genesis 14:3
segments:
Joined together; assembled as allies. 
 
  Vale of Siddim; the southern part of the valley of the Jordan, in which were the cities previously mentioned, (see note)
, and which is now covered by the Dead sea.

entries.title: Genesis 14:4
segments:
Served Chedorlaomer; by paying him tribute. 
 
  Rebelled; refused longer to pay tribute.

entries.title: Genesis 14:5
segments: Ashteroth--Ham--Shaveh Kiriathaim; places east of the Jordan.

entries.title: Genesis 14:6
segments:
Mount Seir; south of the Dead sea. 
 
  El-paran; west of mount Seir.

entries.title: Genesis 14:7
segments:
Kadesh; Kadesh-barnea, in the desert south of Judah. 
 
  Hazezon-tamar; En-gedi, on the west shore of the Dead sea.

entries.title: Genesis 14:10
segments: Slime-pits; places where bitumen, and adhesive and inflammable substance, oozed out of the ground, or where bitumen had been dug out to be used for mortar.
Fell there; were entangled among them and overcome, and many perished.

entries.title: Genesis 14:11
segments: Ever since the apostasy, there have been men who acted as if might gave right; who, if they could, would rob others; and, to obtain their property, put them to death: sins as odious and hateful when committed by rulers and nations, as when committed by private individuals.

entries.title: Genesis 14:12
segments: When men, for worldly purposes, choose to dwell in places distinguished for wickedness, they expose themselves to share in the calamities which that wickedness brings upon the people.

entries.title: Genesis 14:13
segments:
The Hebrew; a name given to Abram, as some suppose, because he descended from Eber, or Heber; and as others think, because he came from beyond the river Euphrates; the word signifying one who has passed over. 
 
  Plain of Mamre;
Confederate with Abram, united with him in opposing his enemies.

entries.title: Genesis 14:14
segments: Brother; here used for nephew.
Dan; perhaps Dan-jaan, mentioned
, and different from the Dan in the northern limit of Palestine, which did not receive this name till long after the death of Moses.

entries.title: Genesis 14:15
segments:
Left hand; to the north. 
 
  Damascus; the capital of ancient Syria; on a plain east of Anti- Lebanon.

entries.title: Genesis 14:16
segments: When men have been robbed of what justly belongs to them, those who are right-minded will abhor the crime, and be disposed, when they can, to take right and effectual measures that what has been taken away may be restored.

entries.title: Genesis 14:17
segments: Shaveh--dale; a valley near Jerusalem.

entries.title: Genesis 14:18
segments:
Melchizedek; a name meaning King of righteousness. 
 
  Salem; meaning in Hebrew, peace,
; supposed to have been the place afterwards called Jerusalem.

entries.title: Genesis 14:20
segments: He gave him tithes; Abram gave to Melchizedek a tenth part.

This was done as an expression of gratitude to God, whose priest Melchizedek was. 
 
Though God often suffers wicked men to take possession of what does not belong to them, such possession gives them no just title to it; and when, in his providence, he restores it, his goodness should be acknowledged, and the praise given to him.

entries.title: Genesis 14:21
segments: Persons and--goods; which Abram had taken from the enemy.

entries.title: Genesis 14:22
segments: Lifted up my hand; taken an oath, or made a solemn promise.

entries.title: Genesis 14:23
segments: Good men, who do right, will be careful to avoid the reality and the appearance of covetousness, and of every thing selfish, niggardly, and mean.

entries.title: Genesis 14:24
segments: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre: the confederates of Abram, mentioned
